paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” refers to generative item scoring, and “ranking” refers to efficient candidate ranking.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled "NDCG@10" presents an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, comparing the performance of the full model ("Ours") against three ablated versions: "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking". The horizontal axis lists the four model variants in the order: "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking". The vertical axis represents the NDCG@10 metric, scaled linearly from 0.05 to 0.25 with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The "Ours" model is represented by a tall orange bar reaching approximately 0.21. The "- critiquing" variant, shown as a blue bar, achieves a value of about 0.18. The "- scoring" variant, also blue, has the lowest performance at approximately 0.07. The "- ranking" variant, another blue bar, reaches a value of roughly 0.12. The bars are arranged left to right in the order of the labels, and no specific sorting or emphasis (e.g., shading or annotations) is applied to any bar. The chart visually demonstrates that removing the scoring component leads to the largest performance drop, while removing critiquing or ranking results in smaller but still significant decreases compared to the full model.
